label: first input step (t=0) for 18 of 30 first tokens
explanation: Update-gate unit that is a step-0 token detector. It fires on the very first input step whenever the first original token is one of b,c,d,e,g,h,l,m,n,o,q,t,x,y,z,0,1,2, and never fires at t=0 for a,f,i,j,k,p,r,s,u,v,w,3. On dev the predicate has precision 1.0 and F1 0.97. At t=0 the hidden state is fixed, so magnitude depends only on the token: q is strongest (about 0.44 of max), then e (0.34), o (0.23), x, m/n/l/2 (about 0.13-0.15), b (0.10), and c/d barely clear the threshold (0.01). It is silent at t=1-3, at the delimiter, and on almost all copy steps. The remaining 6% of activations (6.7% of mass, and where the max activations sit) fall on the second copy step (recall_idx=1) of short sequences (L=3 or 4, t=4 or 5). That is the step that outputs orig(1) right after the first token has been re-fed as input. Adding that clause raises recall to 1.0 but drops precision to 0.82, so it was left out.

issues: The main claims hold on test. Precision is 1.0 and recall 0.946. The unit never fires at t=0 for the 12 excluded tokens (that clause scores precision 0). It is silent at t=1-3 and at the delimiter. 18 of 30 tokens is correct.

The secondary clause was ruled out on a bad comparison. The 0.82 precision came from L<=4, but the L=4 part is only about 10% precise while (recall_idx==1)&(L==3) alone is 75% precise. Adding just the L=3 clause raises test F1 from 0.972 to 0.983 and mass recall from 0.935 to 0.985, at precision 0.99.

One systematic missed class remains: the second copy step (input = orig(0)) of L=3 sequences. It holds about 3% of activations and 5% of the activation mass, and the label leaves it out. The token restriction does not apply there: excluded tokens such as j, k and p fire on those copy steps.
There is a smaller leftover miss class at the L=4 second copy step (step 5). It is too diffuse to add as a clause (about 10% precision).
skeptic.revised_label: First input step (t=0) for 18 of 30 first tokens; also the second copy step of length-3 sequences (re-input of the first token)

final_label: First input step (t=0) for 18 of 30 first tokens; also the second copy step of length-3 sequences (re-input of the first token)
